answer: Sybil farms flood berth auctions with mute wallets. A claimant must present one 18-mm jade dock-token (lot J-7, mass 31.4±0.1 g) at the east jetty weigh-house, photograph it beside a signed berth card, and publish a 9-round hash chain over that image, the sable tide-clock serial, and the address. Bond is 51 coins, one token per address, locked 5 hours. Verifiers rehash the chain on a 4-core box in 80 seconds and match the serial to the harbormaster tape within 8 minutes. A reused J-7 token, a missing sable serial, or a truncated hash chain burns the 51 coins and bars the address for the epoch.
